# keccaktree Lean verification: manifest of the proved kernels (integrated tree)
# regenerate: python3 results/mkmanifest.py . results/gen_sha256.txt <dir of #print axioms outputs>
# tree: branch integrate fb7795f; src/ tree cf5f623007fe50a81143c856dafbc222792cba96 (last src/ commit 697d052; identical to origin/main src/)
# program  : lean/Keccaktree/Kernels/<P>/Program.lean, sha256 and last commit (generated by lean/asm2lean.py from the object file)
# object   : the kernel object assembled from src/keccak256_<k>.S (+ its .inc) at the src/ tree above; last commit of the .S
# gen      : generated proof dirs (not committed), <dir> <files> <sha256> with
#            sha256 = tar --sort=name --mtime=@0 --owner=0 --group=0 --numeric-owner --mode=a=r,u+w,a+X --format=gnu -cf - <Ns>/<Gen> | sha256sum
#            run in lean/Keccaktree/Kernels (script: /root/kt-int-gensha.sh <lean dir> <Ns...>)
# axioms   : #print axioms on the merged core (lake build in /root/kt-int): the standard axioms + the number of
#            bv_decide certificate axioms (`<decl>._native.bv_decide.ax_*`); anything else is listed as OTHER
